claims.statement: The current Seraph shell retains a 5.5 metre clear performance radius and six mirrored feather ribs.
Four distant platforms use 30, 18, 10, and 6 percent of the main deck's hero-frame width.
Each distant platform has a distinct silhouette while preserving the Seraph stone-and-feather vocabulary.
No distant platform intersects the protected central 20 percent of the hero frame.

exemptions.name: first-person-walk
exemptions.rationale: The Celestial scene is a fixed-camera performance background with no player locomotion. The registered desktop, portrait, landscape-phone, top, and profile views are the correct spatial proof.

exemptions.name: route-duration
exemptions.rationale: This fixed-camera environment has an attention sequence rather than a timed walking route.

exemptions.name: sequence-parity
exemptions.rationale: Seraphic Vault Phase 2 carries no selected museum performance sequence or TKA motion data.

checks.name: canon-conflicts
checks.evidence: Gate 0 audit resolves the historical 2026-05 spec beneath the active 2026-08 Seraph direction and keeps the 2D package out of scope.

checks.name: source-digests
checks.evidence: Gate 1 report fingerprints the active spec, Blender builder, runtime owner, config owner, and optimized GLB.

checks.name: walkability
checks.evidence: The existing 5.5 metre central performance radius is unchanged.

checks.name: clearance
checks.evidence: The plan verifier confirms every distant shell clears the main stage envelope.

checks.name: sightlines
checks.evidence: Revision 2 separates every registered-camera platform center by at least 0.15 NDC on both axes, preserves the central band, and clears the desktop outer-feather masks.

checks.name: final-view
checks.evidence: Revision 2 keeps all four platforms visible in desktop, portrait-phone, and landscape-phone frames at the registered NDC targets.

approval.quote: Looks fine to me, let's put it together.

checks.name: artifact-digest
checks.evidence: Gate 2 report records SHA-256 digests for the Blender source, derived coordinate contract, review GLB, five registered renders, verification report, and contact sheet.

checks.name: collision
checks.evidence: All responsive platform shells clear the main sanctuary envelope; the tightest calculated margin is 3.0 metres beyond the combined shell radii.

checks.name: registered-silhouette-clearance
checks.evidence: Blender vertex projection confirms every solid platform silhouette clears every real Meshy feather rib in desktop, portrait, and landscape-phone cameras.

checks.name: projection-parity
checks.evidence: Every responsive platform root lands within 0.0005 NDC of its registered target.

checks.name: review-glb-structure
checks.evidence: The review GLB contains one scene, no cameras, all four platform families, and 46 tagged Gate 2 mesh nodes.
